_comment: Cells are in pixels of the 1448x1086 Lionn character sheet at art/raw/sheets/lionn-character-sheet.png. Layout: title + hero render up top (top ~40%), then 2 rows of 4 numbered cells. Row 1: idle/run/crouch/jump. Row 2: 3-frame claw combo / shadow dash / shadow pounce / wall cling. Crops are inset so the cell number badge and bottom label band are excluded.

groups._comment: Cell 5 (Basic Claw Combo) is wider than cells 6/7/8 because it holds 3 sub-panels. The 3 panels span roughly x=25..495, so each is ~157 wide. Cells 6/7/8 are pushed right of x≈515.
